definitions: A regular gathering of people for the purchase and sale of provisions, livestock, and other commodities.
An area or arena in which commercial dealings are conducted.
The state of trade at a particular time or in a particular commodity.
The demand for a particular commodity or service.
examples: I bought fresh vegetables at the market.
The company is trying to break into the European market.
The stock market was down today.
There's a big market for organic food.
